posts.title: What is product craft in the age of AI and design systems?
posts.description: Ask a design system team how they’ll raise the quality of the products they support, and you’ll usually hear one of two options. The first is to make better components, perhaps with more opinionated defaults. posts.title: How design systems offer creative safety for product teams
posts.description: Before you read any further, answer one question, quietly to yourself: Does your design system create “ sameness” in the products that have adopted it? posts.title: The role of community in the design system space
posts.description: I’ve learned, over the years, to trust my instincts. A few years ago I felt the nudge to find more community in the design system space.
